verdicts.reason: Both candidates share the same problems. The 'LIMITED SUMMER RELEASE' eyebrow has dropped below the headline and is shrunk to unreadable micro-text. The orange divider has been moved under the legal text at the bottom, where it serves no purpose. The SOLSTICE logo is tiny, and the body copy is so large that it competes with the headline. A's four-line headline wrap makes 'Small-Batch' run almost edge to edge with no side margin. B's three-line wrap leaves better side margins but opens up an awkward empty band above the headline.
